title: Last Time Mountaineer Nirmal Purja Was Seen On PoK Peak Before Avalanche Hit
summary_full: Rescuers recovered Purja's body on Sunday after an avalanche killed him and nine team members on one of the world's highest peaks in northern Pakistan.
